description: A battery-electric Tesla with no documents: the curated car list carries ICE items (engine oil, engine air filter, coolant) and a motorcycle chain, which the tailor should rule out (tasks-5).

staticPack.title: Engine oil & filter
staticPack.description: Whichever comes first. Check the manual for the oil grade and the interval that applies to your engine.

staticPack.title: Tire rotation
staticPack.description: Evens out wear across all four tires. Cars and trucks only.

staticPack.title: Engine air filter
staticPack.description: Sooner on dusty roads; a clogged filter costs power and fuel.

staticPack.title: Cabin air filter
staticPack.description: Keeps the ventilation clean. Cars and trucks only.

staticPack.title: Brake fluid flush
staticPack.description: Brake fluid absorbs water over time and loses its boiling point.

staticPack.title: Coolant flush
staticPack.description: Long-life coolants run further — confirm the interval in the manual.

staticPack.title: Registration renewal
staticPack.description: Annual in most places; adjust to your state or province.

staticPack.title: Chain lube & adjustment
staticPack.description: Motorcycles with a chain final drive. Sooner after rain.
